claude_only.name: Which single identifier is the authoritative master identifier for this item, and which agency or system issued it?
What uniqueness and non-reuse guarantee does the issuing scheme give, and over what period?
If no authoritative external identifier exists, which locally minted identifier is used and how is its provenance recorded?
In which syntaxes may this identifier legitimately be expressed for exchange?
How is each identifier physically applied to the item and where on the item is it placed?
Is the mark expected to survive the item's service life, and what happens when it becomes illegible or is removed?
What exactly does the machine-readable carrier encode, and does it resolve to a live information service?
Who is permitted to apply, alter or remove an identity mark on this item?
Given a scanned or quoted identifier, what procedure resolves it to at most one item record?
Which additional identifiers are asserted to designate this same item, and on whose authority?
What is done when two physical things present the same identifier, or one thing presents conflicting identifiers?
How are duplicate records merged or an erroneously merged record split, and how is the prior identifier preserved?
Which type or configuration record does this item instantiate, and in which sibling model is it mastered?
On what evidence was the type resolved: marking, documentation, expert determination or inference?
In what respects does this specimen deviate from its type specification, and are those deviations authorised?
How is an item that cannot be assigned to any known type represented without inventing one?
What physical criterion individuates this thing as one item rather than a part, a set or a quantity?
Which changes preserve identity and which terminate it and create a successor item?
When an item is split, merged or rebuilt, how is lineage to predecessor and successor items recorded?
Who decides a contested continuity case and by what documented rule?
Which properties are measured on this specimen rather than inherited from its type?
By what method and instrument was each value obtained, and with what stated uncertainty?
When was the value measured and when was it recorded, and which one governs currency of the value?
How are conflicting measurements of the same property at the same time reconciled?
Which material classes constitute this item, and in what proportions where known?
Which declarable or hazardous substances are recorded for this individual, and under which regime?
Is the material content declared, tested or inferred from the type specification?
Which parent item does this item form part of at a given instant, and in what position or role?
Which events installed or removed this item from a parent, and who performed them?
Do child components retain their own instance identity while installed, or are they absorbed into the parent?
Where is the full assembly structure mastered, and which parts of it may be cached here?
On what test is a candidate refused an item-instance record and represented as a quantity or batch instead?
How are non-instance contents held inside this item (fluids, consumables, loose parts) represented without minting instances?
Which chain-of-custody model applies to the material in or around this item, and does it preserve identity?
What is the item's current lifecycle status and which event set it?
Which status transitions are permitted from the current status, and which are forbidden?
Which states persist across subsequent events until explicitly cleared, and who may clear them?
How is an item represented whose status is genuinely unknown, and for how long may that persist?
By what mode did the item leave tracked existence, and when?
What evidence proves the terminal event, and who issued it?
Can a terminal state be reversed, for example when a lost item is recovered, and how is the gap recorded?
How long is the record retained after the item ceases to exist, and under what obligation?
What condition grade is asserted, on which named scale, and by whom?
By what method was condition determined: visual inspection, measurement, functional test or declaration?
Which interventions have been performed on this item, by whom, and what did they change?
How stale may a condition assessment be before it must not be presented as current?
Which verification checks were performed on this item, by whom, and with what result?
Which verifiable credentials assert facts about this item, and what is their current status?
What happens when verification fails or when the same identifier is presented on two physical things?
What tamper-evidence exists on marks and carriers, and how is tampering recorded?
Where is the item now believed to be, on the strength of which observation?
Is a given location statement the point where the observation happened or the location the item is considered to be at afterwards?
How was the whereabouts established: scan, sensor, sighting, declaration or inference?
How are contradictory or physically impossible location statements resolved?
What container, handling unit or carrier was the item inside at a given instant?
Which aggregation or disaggregation events changed the item's containment, and when?
How deep may containment nest, and how is the outermost location derived from the innermost item?
Which model masters the container itself, so that its contents are not restated here?
Who holds the item now, since when, and on what basis (ownership, lease, loan, bailment, transport)?
Which transfer moved custody from one party to another, and was it acknowledged by both sides?
What prevents two open custody records existing at once, and how is an overlap corrected?
How are custody gaps recorded when the holder is genuinely unknown for a period?
Who is recorded as owner of this item, and in which model is that assertion mastered?
When holder and owner differ, which record governs each type of decision about the item?
What claims, liens, restitution claims or export restrictions limit dealings with this item?
What minimum fields must an event carry to be a valid statement about this item?
What business step and resulting disposition does the event assert, and from which vocabulary?
How is an erroneous event corrected or retracted without destroying the original assertion?
How are duplicate captures of the same real-world occurrence detected and collapsed?
For each statement, when did the fact occur and when was it observed or ingested?
How is the order of statements decided when event times are equal, missing or inconsistent with record times?
How is an imprecise or historical time expressed without fabricating precision?
Who produced this individual, where and when, and how is that known?
What is the ordered chain of holders from origin to now, and where are the gaps?
Which chain-of-custody model does the chain claim to satisfy, and is that claim independently checked?
How are contested or fabricated provenance claims flagged without deleting them?
Which claim does each item of evidence support, and who issued that evidence?
How is evidence strength graded, and what is the minimum grade for a claim to be published externally?
How is a credential's revocation, suspension or expiry reflected in claims that relied on it?
When two sources make incompatible claims about the item, which prevails and on what recorded rule?
Which system of record masters this item record, and which fields are copies from elsewhere?
Which roles may create, amend or retire each class of statement about the item?
How is a change to the record distinguished from a change to the physical thing?
What retires the record itself, as opposed to ending the item's life?
What is the default visibility of each bundle and layer for a party with no explicit grant?
Which fields may appear in a publicly resolvable view of the item, and which must never appear?
Under what exceptions may withheld data be disclosed, to whom, and with what record?
How are access grants issued, time-boxed and revoked, and what happens to data already disclosed?
Which fields link the item to an identifiable natural person, directly or by combination?
How long is each class of item data retained, on what legal or contractual basis?
How is an erasure request reconciled with traceability, safety or product-passport duties that require retention?
What correlation risk arises from a persistent, publicly resolvable item identifier, and how is it mitigated?
For each external standard, which of its terms does a given element of this model map to, and is the mapping exact, broader or narrower?
Where do external standards contradict one another about the same fact, and how is the contradiction recorded rather than hidden?
Which version of each external vocabulary is the mapping valid against, and how is drift detected?
What evidence would be required before claiming conformance to a given external standard?
Which outbound projection is required for a given consumer, and which fields does it draw from?
Does an external payload bind to the item instance, to a batch or to the model, and is that level stated explicitly?
What accuracy, availability and update duties attach once data is published to an external regime, and who is responsible?
How is divergence detected between a published projection and the current internal record?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this item, in which register is it native, and what is its IRI if one exists?

Which governed global identifiers currently denote this same instance (SGTIN, GIAI, serialised GRAI, IEC 61406 IL, ESPR unique product identifier at item grain, AAS globalAssetId), and which are aliases versus former identifiers?
If no master-system or governed global identifier exists, what UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign, and when was it assigned?
Does each recorded key actually identify this one object, or is it a type, lot, model or logistic-unit key that must be moved to a sibling classifier or handling-unit link?
Who issued each identifier (manufacturer, asset owner or manager, catalogue Dimension, regulator), under which prefix or namespace, and is that party still the issuing authority?
For each identifier, is reuse forbidden for a period beyond the lifetime of the item records, and has this value ever been previously bound to another item?
When title or custody changes, does this identifier remain with the physical object, get withdrawn, or get replaced by the new owner's identifier?
What marking methods and data carriers are present on this item (engraving, stamp, label, GS1 2D symbol, RFID, NFC, IEC 61406 IL, handwritten accession mark), and where on the object is each applied?
Was each mark applied at manufacture, applied later, or discovered already on the object, and what are the event time and record time of that fact?
Does the carrier encode only a local serial, a GS1 Digital Link, an IEC 61406 IL URL, or another resolvable IRI, and what URL is actually encoded?
Is each identifier mark currently legible, damaged, over-labelled, removed or only photographically documented, and when was that assessed?
What Object ID-style distinguishing features, inscriptions or damage patterns uniquely describe this object even if serials are absent or cloned?
Is there evidence that a presented identifier is cloned, counterfeit, reused or bound to another item, and what is the confidence and evidence of that suspicion?

What resolvable IRI or URL currently identifies this physical object (IEC 61406 IL, GS1 Digital Link with AI 21, DPP unique product identifier), and does it encode instance grain rather than type or lot?
Which digital representations (DPP, AAS, other twin) describe this item, what are their own identifiers, and which of those identifiers are explicitly not the item master?
If a DPP or similar passport exists, what unique operator identifier and unique facility identifier are bound to this item instance, and at which production event?
What product type, model or other class does this item instantiate, in which sibling model does that class live, and with what resolution confidence?
If kind is unknown, disputed or the object is unique (museum exhibit, one-off), is the kind deliberately absent, a broad CIDOC type, or a local class, and who asserted it?
Has the resolved class changed over time (mislabel, retrofit, counterfeit revealed), and what is the history of kind assertions with event and record times?
What product configuration or variant, if any, classifies this configured instance, and is that a sibling configuration master rather than an extra serial?
From which lot or batch was this instance produced or separated, and is that lot used only as provenance rather than as the item identifier?
Which instance-level master data attributes (EPCIS ILMD such as expiration) belong to this instance rather than to the type, and what is their validity window?
What measured dimensions, weight or other quantitative characteristics were taken from this instance, with unit, method, measurer, event time and record time?
If maker, production place, country of origin, country of assembly or production date are known for this instance, what are they, and which of those facts actually belong to the type?
Is this a human-made object (CIDOC E22), a natural physical thing taken into tracking, or unknown, and what evidence supports that classification?
Which material-class identifiers constitute this item, in which sibling material model do they live, and is the statement typical-of-type or observed-on-instance?
Which instance-specific replacements, coatings, repairs or contaminants changed constitution after production, and when?
Are making techniques recorded as instance evidence (especially for unique objects) or only as type process knowledge that should live elsewhere?
What is the latest condition grade or OfferItemCondition-aligned value for this item, who assessed it, by what method, and at what event time versus record time?
What prior assessments exist, including after repair, inspection, damage or recovery, and do they form an ordered history rather than a single overwritten field?
Which defects remain open, which have been repaired or replaced, and which component instances were swapped (those swaps are also containment changes)?
What is the current CBV-aligned disposition immediately after the latest event, and what is the current persistentDisposition if one has been set?

Which business step (for example commissioning, encoding, inspecting, receiving, shipping, packing, removing, sampling, sensor_reporting) produced the current state, and was the event ADD, DELETE or OBSERVE?
Is state expressed in CBV, a local asset-status list, a museum status list, or mixed, and where do those vocabularies conflict on this item?
When was this individual thing produced, collected, commissioned or first seen, distinguishing physical existence time from first-tracking time and from record time?
Is the item still an existing physical object, transformed into successors, consumed, destroyed, recycled, or only administratively retired, and what evidence supports that?
After disposal, which identifiers are embargoed from reuse and until when, given GS1 non-reuse beyond record lifetime?
Is the item missing to its holder, reported stolen, seized by authority, in dispute, or merely not recently observed, and when was that status asserted?
If previously missing or stolen, when was it recovered or returned, by whom, and did identity, condition or custody need re-validation?
Has a museum, court or owner deaccessioned, forfeited or legally abandoned the item, and does that end title, custody, or only collection membership?
What is the current trusted location of this item as a place or premises reference, with read-point versus business-location if both exist, precision, source, event time and record time?
What ordered historical location fixes exist, including last-known location while missing, and which fix was superseded by which later fix?
Is current location confidential (high-value, seized, private residence), and which disclosure scopes may see it?
What handling unit, package, vehicle load or other logistics parent currently contains this item, with parent identifier, aggregation action history and event times?
If the item is not in a handling unit, is it loose at a place, installed in an assembly, or unknown, and which of those states is authoritative?
Was completeness of the parent verified or only inferred (CBV completeness_verified vs completeness_inferred), and does that affect trust in this membership?
Is this item currently a component of an as-built assembly, in which position or role, installed when, and what is the parent item or assembly identifier?
If this item is itself a parent, which child item instances are currently installed, and which have been removed or cannibalized?
Did a composition change consume this identity and generate a new item (transformation), or is it the same item with different components?
Who currently possesses or holds this item, under what basis (ownership, bailment, lease, consignment, loan, exhibition, repair, seizure, unknown), and when did that period start?
What ordered custody periods exist, including open and closed intervals, transfer events, and gaps when holder was unknown?
What business transaction, receipt, sensor observation or attestation supports the latest custody transfer, and who attested it to whom?
Who is asserted to hold legal title or equivalent ownership of this item, in which jurisdiction, on what basis, and is that distinct from the current possessor?
What title-transfer events exist, with from-party, to-party, instrument, event time and record time, including partial interests if evidenced?
For which organizations is this item currently an ISO 55000 asset (has value to that organization), and is that recorded as a view over this item rather than as another master id?
Which party currently stewards this item record, is that the owner, a delegated registrar or a documentation authority, and when did stewardship start?
Who may grant read or write access to which bundles of this item, and are grants time-bounded?
When title transfers, does record stewardship transfer automatically, remain with a registrar, or split (for example public passport vs private history)?
For a caller who presents only a serial or IL, what fields may be returned (existence, kind, lifecycle status) and which must be withheld (location, holder, condition detail, owner)?
If a DPP or similar passport applies, which fields are mandated for public or regulator view, and which remain owner-only?
Which exceptional recipients (repairer, valuer, insurer, police, customs) have been granted which scopes, for which interval, and on what legal or owner basis?
What events in this item's history are known, with type, action, event time, record time, event id or hash, and which identifier of the item was observed?
Was each event about this specific instance, a class/lot of which this instance is a member, or mixed, and is class-level inference flagged as inferred?
What How-dimension sensor measurements accompanied the event, with quantity, unit, sensor id, and measurement time?
Did a transformation consume this item as input, and which output item identities were generated, with event time and record time?
From which prior items, lots or materials was this item derived, and is that derivation generation, assembly, split or other?
Is there a conflict between a recorded transformation (new identity) and a recorded repair (same identity), and which statement is authoritative?
Which activity generated this item as a PROV entity, which agents were associated, and which entities were used as inputs?
Who is the responsible agent for the latest identity, location, custody and condition assertions, and are those agents persons, organizations or software?
For each provenance statement, does it describe the physical object, the digital record about the object, or both, and how are those graphs separated?
What photographs, scans, certificates, sensor readings or documents support that this record denotes the physical object in hand, and where is that evidence kept?
What confidence or completeness attaches to current identity, location, custody and condition, and is completeness verified or inferred?
Which current statements fail identifier, time, granularity or uniqueness validation, and are they quarantined rather than treated as fact?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
